summary: Hold FYI mail until the next wake, allow question-only seats, and expose coordination counts

replay.detail: No graph replay or projection invalidation. Local coordination metadata backfills at most eight historical message subjects per paced job on the existing FIFO writer, with a 100-millisecond pause between jobs; count reads return complete=false until caught up and never advance the backfill.

schema.detail: Adds derived coordination_sends timestamp/count flags and held flag, covering time/held indexes, a guarded receipt trigger, and local_coordination_backfill cursor/ceiling/progress. Numeric schema version is unchanged. No conversation payload is newly stored.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules version, canonical graph digest, or sealing rule change. New count tables are local derived metadata.

compatibility.detail: Adds optional fyi/question message.send booleans and wake-on KDL/commands. Old daemons silently ignore typed flags and deliver FYI-tagged messages normally; old CLIs reject flags. Upgrade all owner daemons before setting wake-on: an old owner or downgrade can restart a seat on this declaration change and removes no-wake guarantees. CLI warns on an agent FYI receipt missing the FYI tag; SDK receipt warnings are deferred, so mixed-version callers must inspect tags. Person signatures retain signed tags and always wake. External Rust struct literals need the two boolean fields.

downtime.detail: Normal binary swap/restart; no numeric schema migration. Empty derived tables and indexes are created, then bounded background jobs fill metadata. Held diagnostics select at most 128 indexed rows, delivery hydrates at most eight held subjects. Populated restart-to-health timings have not been measured.

manual.detail: Set wake-on questions in agent KDL or use agents wake-on AGENT questions --as ACTOR after upgrading. Explicit FYI and question flags are opt-in. The companion factory collector needs the upgraded count-only endpoint and waits for complete metadata before publishing ratios. See docs/st3/fyi-messages.md.

recovery.detail: Unstaged FYIs remain unread, excluded from backlog cleanup, and survive polling/reconnect. Each real wake offers at most eight newest FYIs with an older-held notice; on-demand reads see all. Downgrade removes no-wake guarantees and can restart wake-on seats. Roll-forward reopens uncovered sends after an old binary. Corrupt source fails closed (never falsely complete); usage exposes cursor/ceiling/progress and doctor warns after 15 minutes stalled. Repair source with existing recovery procedures.
